columns.name: sample_id
columns.description: Unique deterministic hex identifier generated from SHA-256 of registrable domain and observation timestamp.

columns.name: normalized_domain
columns.description: Normalized, lowercase FQDN evaluated during the measurement.

columns.name: registrable_domain
columns.description: Effective registrable domain extracted via the Public Suffix List (e.g., example.co.uk). Must be strictly unique across the primary dataset.

columns.name: scan_timestamp
columns.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp recording when the observation was initiated.

columns.name: source_name
columns.description: Identifier of the population source (e.g. SRC-TRANCO-1M-RESEARCH).

columns.name: source_reference
columns.description: Rank or external identifier in the primary population list.

columns.name: collection_method
columns.description: Collection approach used (e.g., PASSIVE_PROBE, SYNTHETIC_LAB).

columns.name: collection_status
columns.description: Collection outcome: SUCCESS, PARTIAL, UNREACHABLE, TIMEOUT, DNS_FAILURE.

columns.name: dataset_version
columns.description: Semantic version of the dataset schema and pipeline.

columns.name: url_scheme
columns.description: Initial URL scheme used for primary connection test (https or http).

columns.name: url_length
columns.description: Character length of the target URL.

columns.name: subdomain_count
columns.description: Number of subdomain labels preceding the registrable domain.

columns.name: is_idn
columns.description: Whether the domain is an Internationalized Domain Name (Punycode).

columns.name: is_ip_host
columns.description: Whether the host is an IPv4 or IPv6 address instead of a domain.

columns.name: domain_resolved
columns.description: Whether DNS resolution returned at least one valid IP address.

columns.name: dns_has_ipv4
columns.description: Whether domain resolved one or more A records.

columns.name: dns_has_ipv6
columns.description: Whether domain resolved one or more AAAA records.

columns.name: dns_ipv4_addresses
columns.description: List of resolved IPv4 addresses.

columns.name: dns_has_caa
columns.description: Whether domain publishes a Certification Authority Authorization record.

columns.name: tls_supported
columns.description: Whether a direct TLS handshake was negotiated successfully on port 443.

columns.name: tls_version
columns.description: Negotiated TLS protocol version: TLSv1.3, TLSv1.2, TLSv1.1, TLSv1.0.

columns.name: tls_cipher
columns.description: Negotiated cryptographic cipher suite name.

columns.name: tls_cert_valid
columns.description: Whether leaf certificate temporal validity is currently valid.

columns.name: tls_cert_expired
columns.description: Whether leaf certificate expiration date is in the past.

columns.name: tls_cert_not_before
columns.description: Certificate validity commencement in ISO 8601 UTC.

columns.name: tls_cert_not_after
columns.description: Certificate validity expiration in ISO 8601 UTC.

columns.name: tls_cert_remaining_days
columns.description: Days remaining until leaf certificate expiration.

columns.name: tls_cert_issuer
columns.description: Distinguished Name (RFC 4514) of the certificate issuer.

columns.name: tls_cert_subject
columns.description: Distinguished Name of the certificate subject.

columns.name: tls_cert_san_count
columns.description: Number of Subject Alternative Names declared on the certificate.

columns.name: tls_cert_is_self_signed
columns.description: Whether the leaf certificate is self-signed (subject equals issuer).

columns.name: tls_cert_hostname_match
columns.description: Whether the requested domain matches at least one SAN entry or CN.

columns.name: tls_cert_sig_alg
columns.description: Signature algorithm used by issuer to sign certificate.

columns.name: tls_cert_key_size
columns.description: Public key bit length (e.g. 2048, 4096, 256 for ECC).

columns.name: http_available
columns.description: Whether plain HTTP (port 80) responds with an HTTP status code.

columns.name: https_available
columns.description: Whether HTTPS (port 443) responds with an HTTP status code.

columns.name: http_to_https_redirect
columns.description: Whether plain HTTP requests automatically redirect (301/302/308) to HTTPS.

columns.name: redirect_count
columns.description: Number of redirect hops followed before reaching final destination.

columns.name: final_status_code
columns.description: HTTP status code received at the terminal response.

columns.name: final_scheme
columns.description: URL scheme of the terminal response (https or http).

columns.name: https_downgrade
columns.description: Whether the redirect sequence redirected an HTTPS URL to plain HTTP.

columns.name: header_hsts_present
columns.description: Whether Strict-Transport-Security header was returned over HTTPS.

columns.name: header_hsts_max_age
columns.description: Declared max-age parameter in HSTS header in seconds.

columns.name: header_hsts_include_subdomains
columns.description: Whether HSTS includes the includeSubDomains directive.

columns.name: header_hsts_preload
columns.description: Whether HSTS declares the preload directive.

columns.name: header_csp_present
columns.description: Whether Content-Security-Policy header is present in the response.

columns.name: header_csp_unsafe_inline
columns.description: Whether CSP script-src includes 'unsafe-inline'.

columns.name: header_csp_unsafe_eval
columns.description: Whether CSP script-src includes 'unsafe-eval'.

columns.name: header_xfo_present
columns.description: Whether X-Frame-Options header is present.

columns.name: header_xfo_value
columns.description: Declared value of X-Frame-Options (e.g. DENY, SAMEORIGIN).

columns.name: header_xcto_present
columns.description: Whether X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff is set.

columns.name: header_referrer_policy_present
columns.description: Whether Referrer-Policy header is present.

columns.name: header_referrer_policy_value
columns.description: Declared value of Referrer-Policy.

columns.name: header_permissions_policy_present
columns.description: Whether Permissions-Policy header is present.

columns.name: header_coop_present
columns.description: Whether Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy header is present.

columns.name: header_corp_present
columns.description: Whether Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy header is present.

columns.name: header_coep_present
columns.description: Whether Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy header is present.

columns.name: cookie_count
columns.description: Total number of Set-Cookie directives observed.

columns.name: cookie_secure_count
columns.description: Number of cookies with the 'Secure' attribute.

columns.name: cookie_httponly_count
columns.description: Number of cookies with the 'HttpOnly' attribute.

columns.name: cookie_samesite_strict_count
columns.description: Number of cookies declaring SameSite=Strict.

columns.name: cookie_samesite_lax_count
columns.description: Number of cookies declaring SameSite=Lax.

columns.name: cookie_samesite_none_count
columns.description: Number of cookies declaring SameSite=None.

columns.name: cookie_all_secure
columns.description: Whether 100% of observed cookies carry the Secure attribute.

columns.name: server_header
columns.description: Sanitized Server response header banner.

columns.name: server_version_exposed
columns.description: Whether server banner discloses specific version digits.

columns.name: x_powered_by_present
columns.description: Whether X-Powered-By header was exposed.

columns.name: findings
columns.description: JSON-encoded array of detailed security finding objects.

columns.name: finding_ids
columns.description: List of active finding identifiers triggered for this endpoint.

columns.name: critical_findings_count
columns.description: Count of CRITICAL severity findings.

columns.name: high_findings_count
columns.description: Count of HIGH severity findings.

columns.name: medium_findings_count
columns.description: Count of MEDIUM severity findings.

columns.name: low_findings_count
columns.description: Count of LOW severity findings.

columns.name: website_posture_label
columns.description: Categorical security posture rating: GOOD, MODERATE, POOR, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

columns.name: website_posture_score
columns.description: Comprehensive numerical security posture score between 0.0 and 100.0.

columns.name: annotation_method
columns.description: Methodology identifier used to generate labels (RULE_BASED_STANDARDS_V1).

columns.name: annotation_version
columns.description: Version of the annotation logic applied.
